# <span id="aanchor92"></span> Export Template Editor

You must have **Can Create**, **Can Delete**, or **Can Edit** privileges for the FLOWCAL Options Application Process to create, delete, or modify templates, respectively. Users who do not have these privileges will still be able to access this screen and view the export templates.

Use the Export Template Editor to view, create, modify, and delete text file export templates. The standard GasTextFileExchange export format is available as a standard template called “GasTextFileExchange”.

<div class="procedure">

To access the Export Template Editor:

1.  Go to **Reports** \> **Exports**.
2.  Select the **GasTextFileExchange.dll** export.
3.  Click the browse button next to the **Export Template** field.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 580;height: 440;" />

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Create">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Creating an Export Template</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Create">

<div class="procedure">

To create an export template:

1.  Click the **New** button to create a new template, or click the **Copy** button to copy an existing template.
2.  Select an export template in the Select Template to Copy dialog.
3.  Enter a name for the export template in the **Export Template** field.
4.  Continue to step 2 of Modifying an Export Template below to complete the template setup.

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Modify">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Modifying an Export Template</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Modify">

<div class="procedure">

To make changes to an export template:

1.  Select an existing user-created template in the Export Template drop-down and click the **Edit** button.
2.  Choose a delimiter:
    - **Tab** - A tab (→) is used as a separator between export values.
    - **Comma** - A comma (,) is used as a separator between export values.
    - **Space** - A single space ( ) is used as a separator between export values.
    - **Pipe** - A pipe (\|) is used as a separator between export values.
    - **Other** - Specify a single character to be used as a separator between export values.
3.  Select a print option:
    - **Print Headers** - If this option is enabled, the field names are included in the first row of the export file.
    - **Enclosure Character** - Check this option and enter a single character to be included on both sides of each export value.
      <div class="example">

      <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerBRDToggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_BRDToggler MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Example">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Example</a>

      If the Atmospheric Pressure value is 14.696 and the enclosure character is a double quote (“), “14.696” is used for the field in the export file.

      </div>
4.  Select fields to be included or excluded in the export file by clicking and highlighting a field in the Available Fields list or the Selected Fields list and using the left and right arrow buttons to select or deselect fields. Double-clicking a field also moves the field between lists.
5.  Set the order of the selected fields. Fields are included in a export data line in the order listed in the Selected Fields list (listed from top to bottom). Highlight a field and use the up and down arrow buttons located to the right of the Selected Fields list to reorder the fields.
6.  For fields in the Selected Fields list, right-click a field to display the Set Field Print Options menu.
7.  Click the Set Field Print Options menu item to open the Field Print Options dialog.
    - **Database Value** - The value stored in the database for the selected field will be printed.
    - **Blank Field** - "Blank" will be printed for the selected field.
    - **Constant Value** - A user-specified string of up to 250 characters will be printed for the selected field.
8.  Click **OK** and close the dialog. The print option will display for the selected field in the Selected Fields list under the Value column.

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="View">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Viewing Associated Export Schedules</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="View">

<div class="procedure">

To view an existing export template:

1.  Select the template in the **Export Template** drop-down.
2.  Click the **Associated Schedules** button next to the Export Template drop-down to see all export schedules that currently use the selected template.

</div>

</div>

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="Delete">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />Deleting an Export Template</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="Delete">

<div class="procedure">

To delete an existing export template:

Click the **Delete** button while viewing the template.

You cannot delete the template if it is currently used in an export group or scheduled export. Before the template can be deleted, the template must be removed from the export group and the schedule, or the export group and the schedule must be deleted.

</div>

</div>
